school: 元末明初'以演义立法历史想象'的叙事体系构建者：以尊刘贬曹的义理透镜裁剪三百年史料，以七实三虚的配比把虚构安装在不可辩驳的骨架上，以桃园结义把'义'写成可执行的誓言制度，以'分久必合'的开篇定律给百年人事一个长周期结构，以对写与温酒刻度完成群像的性格显影，最终以说书接口让作品在瓦舍与戏台之间活了六百年——他是把一部书写成民族历史想象操作系统的人
historical_significance: 罗贯中（约1330-约1400），名本，字贯中，号湖海散人，太原人（一说东原/钱塘）；贾仲明《录鬼簿续编》记其'与余为忘年交''遭时多故'，明王圻《稗史汇编》称其'有志图王'——正史无传，生卒与生平几乎全部存疑；相传曾为张士诚幕客，后'不得已而寓于著述'；《三国志通俗演义》以陈寿《三国志》与裴松之注为骨架，采《三国志平话》与民间传说，'文不甚深，言不甚俗'（庸愚子序），尊刘贬曹、七实三虚，是中国第一部长篇章回体历史演义；另有《隋唐两朝志传》《残唐五代史演义》《三遂平妖传》等题名其下，并与施耐庵并称于《水浒传》；毛宗岗父子于清初整理评点后，《三国演义》定型为通行本；他证明：一个在乱世抱负无处安放的人，可以把自己压缩进一部书，让书代替他工作六百年
historical_significance_en: Luo Guanzhong (c. 1330-c. 1400), given name Ben, courtesy Guanzhong, sobriquet the Wanderer of Lakes and Seas, a native of Taiyuan (some say Dongyuan or Qiantang); Jia Zhongming's supplement to the Register of Ghosts records him as the writer's 'friend across the years,' 'tossed by the troubled times,' and Wang Qi's Ming miscellany says he 'had kingly ambitions' — no biography in the standard histories, his dates and life almost wholly uncertain; said to have served as adviser to Zhang Shicheng, then 'perforce to lodge himself in writing'; his Romance of the Three Kingdoms, built on Chen Shou's History and Pei Songzhi's notes, drawing on the Pinghua and the tales of the people, 'its prose not too deep, its speech not too vulgar' (the preface of Yongyuzi), exalting Liu Bei and demeaning Cao Cao, seven parts fact and three fiction, is the first full-length chapter-cycle historical novel of China; other works bear his name, and he is paired with Shi Nai'an on the Water Margin; the Mao Zonggangs' Qing recension fixed the received text; he proved: a man whose ambitions found no place in a broken age can compress himself into one book and let the book work six hundred years in his stead
unique_thinking: 罗贯中的独特处在于：他把'历史'当作可以被叙事重装的操作系统——骨架照搬史册，因果与意义全部重写；他第一个证明立场可以是公开的方法而非隐藏的偏见（尊刘贬曹写进每一处的配重）；他发明了让虚构借用历史信用的配比技术（七实三虚），让一部小说从此承担了半个史学的功能；他保留说书接口，让作品在每个不识字的村庄里活着；而他本人从作品里彻底退场——正史无传而书传六百年，'三国'属于每一个讲它的人
unique_thinking_en: Luo Guanzhong's singularity: he treated 'history' as an operating system that narrative could reload — the skeleton copied from the archives, the causes and meanings rewritten entire; he was the first to prove that stance can be a published method and not a hidden bias (exalt Liu, demean Cao, in the weighting of every page); he invented the ratio by which fiction borrows history's credit — seven parts fact, three fiction — so that a novel thenceforth did half the work of a historiography; he kept the storyteller interface, and the work lived in every village that could not read; and he exited his own work completely — no biography in the histories, the book six hundred years, and 'the Three Kingdoms' belonging to everyone who tells it
civilization_zh: 元末明初——旧王朝崩解、新王朝草创的时代，一个'有志图王'而不得的乱世亲历者，把百年兴替压缩进一部茶馆里被讲述的书
civilization_en: The close of Yuan and the start of Ming — an age when an old dynasty collapsed and a new was being born; a witness of the disorder whose kingly ambitions found no place, compressing a century of rise and fall into a book meant to be told aloud in a teahouse
roles_zh: 民间说书传统的整理者
政治抱负不得志的著述者
key_works: 《三国志通俗演义》（中国第一部长篇章回历史演义）
《残唐五代史演义传》（题罗贯中）

cross_references.description_zh: 罗贯中与蒲松龄同为'借虚构对历史与现实行使裁判权'的体系构建者，且都在为材料争名分：罗贯中以'演义'接通史部传统（晋平阳侯陈寿史传—通俗演义的题记），让小说挤进'资治'的阅读契约；蒲松龄以'异史氏'接通史家论赞，让志怪获得史书体例的规格——同一件事（为虚构发史家通行证），一个用于兴替大历史，一个用于民间小叙事；差异在罗向群体记忆与组织智慧展开，蒲向制度批判与个体命运展开。
cross_references.description_en: Luo Guanzhong and Pu Songling are both system-builders who wield judgment over history and reality through fiction, and both win standing for their material: Luo joins the romance to the tradition of history — 'the history of Chen Shou' on the title page — letting a novel enter the reading contract of statecraft; Pu joins the strange to the historian's closing remarks, winning the strange the grade of the annals — the same work, issuing fiction the historian's passport, one spent on the grand history of rise and fall, the other on the small narratives of the people; Luo opens onto collective memory and the wisdom of organization, Pu onto institutional critique and individual fate.

cross_references.relation_note: 对比：历史演义的神魔化与神魔小说的官僚化
cross_references.description_zh: 罗贯中与吴承恩同为明代长篇章回的奠基者，都在历史或神话的外壳里写组织与权力：罗写人间王朝的兴替（庙堂、军政、结义），吴写神界官僚的运作（天庭、地府、山头）——两人共享章回接口与程式化叙事，差异在罗的权力有历史骨架约束（结局不可改写），吴的权力是全虚构的自由宇宙（结局可由心猿改写）——同一个问题（组织如何吞噬个体），一个在史实里作答，一个在神话里作答。
cross_references.description_en: Luo Guanzhong and Wu Cheng'en, both founders of the Ming chapter-cycle, write organization and power inside the shells of history and myth: Luo the rise and fall of human dynasties — courts, armies, oaths; Wu the working of the celestial bureaucracy — heaven's court, the underworld, the mountain strongholds; they share the chapter-cycle interface and programmatic narrative, and differ in that Luo's power is bound by the skeleton of history (the ending may not be rewritten) while Wu's is a wholly fictive universe (the ending may be rewritten by the mind-ape) — one question, how organizations devour individuals, answered in history by the one and in myth by the other.

cross_references.description_zh: 罗贯中与董仲舒同做'给混沌历史立法'的工作：董仲舒以天人感应与三统说为王朝更替提供宇宙论解释（谁该当王、为何改朝），罗贯中以'分久必合，合久必分'为兴替提供叙事定律（为何三分、为何归晋）——两人都把'改朝换代'从偶然事件升格为规律现象；差异在董的定律面向王朝合法性服务，罗的定律面向读者理解与安慰服务。
cross_references.description_en: Luo Guanzhong and Dong Zhongshu both legislate for chaotic history: Dong with the resonance of heaven and man and the three cycles gives dynastic change a cosmological explanation — who deserves the throne, why dynasties turn; Luo with 'long divided must unite, long united must divide' gives it a narrative law — why three kingdoms, why the Jin conquest; both raise the change of dynasties from accident to regularity; Dong's law serves the legitimacy of courts, Luo's the understanding and consolation of readers.

cross_references.description_zh: 罗贯中与凯撒同处'军事领袖兼书写者'的位置，方向相反：凯撒以当事人身份写《高卢战记》，用第一人称叙事为自己竞选与辩护——书写是权力的工具；罗贯中'有志图王'而不得，退出权力现场，以旁观者的演义为百年兴替立法——书写是权力的替代品与清算——对照命题：对同一个失败（政治抱负落空），可以留在场内把书写成武器（凯撒），也可以退到场外把书写成审判（罗贯中）。
cross_references.description_en: Luo Guanzhong and Caesar stand in the same place — a military leader who writes — facing opposite ways: Caesar writes the Gallic War as the man in the arena, first-person narrative as campaign and defense — writing as an instrument of power; Luo, his kingly ambitions thwarted, leaves the arena of power and legislates a century of rise and fall as an onlooker's romance — writing as power's substitute and its settling of accounts — the contrast: at the same failure, the collapse of political ambition, one may stay inside and forge writing into a weapon, or step outside and forge it into a judgment.

modes.name_en: The Method of the Righteous Lens
modes.category: 认知方法/以义理透镜裁剪史料
modes.domain_zh: 罗贯中面对三国三百年纷杂史料，做的第一件事不是兼收并蓄，而是立一块义理透镜：尊刘贬曹。刘备集团被写成'仁义'的载体，曹操被写成'奸'的载体——同一件史实（曹操屠徐州与刘备携民渡江都被记录），经过透镜后获得完全不同的叙事重量。这个判断的深意在于：第一，立场先于材料——没有任何叙事者是透明的，与其假装中立，不如公开亮出裁决标准，让全部选材、详略、褒贬服从一个可辩护的原则；第二，透镜制造记忆——'曹操'在民间成为白脸奸雄、'关羽'成为义绝之神，不是史书写成的，是演义立场浇铸成的；第三，立场必须给出代价——罗贯中同时让刘备哭、让关羽败走麦城，义的一方并不因此不败，透镜才不沦为宣传。他证明：叙事者的第一产品不是故事，是裁决标准
modes.domain_en: Facing three centuries of tangled materials on the Three Kingdoms, Luo Guanzhong's first act was not to gather everything but to set one righteous lens: exalt Liu Bei, demean Cao Cao. Liu Bei's camp is written as the carrier of benevolence and righteousness, Cao Cao's as the carrier of treachery — the same facts (Cao's massacre of Xuzhou, Liu's flight with the people) pass through the lens and come out with wholly different narrative weight. The depth of the judgment: first, stance precedes material — no narrator is transparent; rather than feign neutrality, publish your standard of judgment openly and let all selection, emphasis and praise serve one defensible principle; second, the lens manufactures memory — that 'Cao Cao' became the white-faced villain and 'Guan Yu' the god of fidelity in folk memory was not the work of historians but of a novel's stance, cast in bronze; third, a stance must pay its price — Luo lets Liu Bei weep and Guan Yu lose Jing Province; the righteous side does not thereby win, and so the lens never sinks into propaganda. He proved: the narrator's first product is not a story but a standard of judgment
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志通俗演义》全书立场；'拥刘反曹'民间叙事传统的定型
modes.key_quote_zh: 同一史料，两种重量：屠徐州者成'奸雄'，携民渡江者成'仁主'——立场是叙事者的第一产品
modes.key_quote_en: "One archive, two weights: the butcher of Xuzhou becomes the hero-villain, the man who fled carrying his people becomes the benevolent lord — stance is the narrator's first product"
process_zh: 在动笔前公开你的裁决标准：不用假装中立，把'我按什么原则褒贬'写成明规则——标准可辩护，叙事才有骨头
用透镜决定配重而非真伪：不删改事实，而是决定谁登场、谁详写、谁一笔带过——立场在配重里，不在造假里
给对立面以真实的力量：被贬的一方必须强大、聪明、有理——打倒稻草人不叫立场，赢过强者才叫
承受立场的代价：让义的一方也失败、也缺陷——有代价的立场才是判断，无代价的立场只是广告
process_en: Publish your standard of judgment before you write: do not feign neutrality; write down 'by what principle I praise and blame' as an open rule — a defensible standard gives the narrative its spine
Let the lens set emphasis, not truth: alter no fact; decide who appears, who is told at length, who in one line — the stance lives in the weighting, not in forgery
Give the opposing side real strength: the demeaned side must be strong, clever, even right — to topple a straw man is not a stance; to beat a strong one is
Pay the price of your stance: let the righteous lose, let them be flawed — a stance with cost is a judgment; a stance without cost is an advertisement
representative_cases_zh: 曹操与刘备对写：'宁教我负天下人'与'吾宁死，不为不仁不义之事'两句自白，把两人钉在奸与义两极——全书一切选材围绕这两句展开
关羽由史入神：史书中的降将瑕疵被演义的'降汉不降曹、秉烛达旦、挂印封金'逐一洗成义的光环——透镜重塑历史记忆的实证
曹操的复杂性保留：横槊赋诗的才、哭郭嘉的情、割发代首的权谋自省——被贬者仍被写成第一流人物，透镜才立得住
representative_cases_en: Cao Cao and Liu Bei written against each other: 'Better I betray the world than the world betray me' against 'I would die before doing what is not benevolent and not righteous' — two self-declarations pinning the pair at the poles of treachery and fidelity, around which all selection in the book revolves

Guan Yu from history to godhead: the surrendered general's stains in the annals are washed, item by item, into the halo of fidelity — surrendered to Han not Cao, candle lit till dawn, seal hung and gold refused — the lens remaking historical memory before our eyes

Cao Cao's complexity preserved: the talent of lancing poetry across a spear, the grief of weeping for Guo Jia, the self-audit of cutting his own hair in lieu of his head — the demeaned side written first-rate, or the lens would not stand
modern_applications_zh: 先亮标准再写报告：研究、评论、尽调先声明评价框架（按什么判好坏），读者可检验、可反驳——可信度反而上升
用'配重'表达立场：不造假数据，而是决定把什么放头版、什么放脚注——编辑立场即叙事立场
给对手最强版本：辩论、竞品分析、写史，都把对方写成最强形态再赢——对稻草人的胜利一文不值
modern_applications_en: Publish the standard before the report: state the evaluative frame in research, commentary, due diligence — what makes good and bad — and the reader can test and rebut it; credibility rises
Express stance through weighting: falsify no data; decide what makes the front page and what the footnote — editorial weight is narrative stance
Steelman the opposition: in debate, competitor analysis, or history, write the other side at full strength and beat them there — a victory over straw is worthless

modes.name_en: The Method of Seven Parts Fact, Three Parts Fiction
modes.category: 认知方法/在史实骨架上做虚构增量
modes.domain_zh: 章学诚后来评《三国演义》：'七分实事，三分虚构，以至观者往往为所惑乱'——这七个字精确描述了罗贯中的构造方法：大的骨架（黄巾、官渡、赤壁、六出祁山、三国归晋）全部钉死在史册上，虚构只在骨架的缝隙里生长（草船借箭的细节、借东风的仪式、空城计的移植）。这个判断的深意在于：第一，骨架给虚构发通行证——正因为朝代、战役、结局不可辩驳，缝隙里的虚构才被读者当作可信的填充接受；第二，虚构负责因果——史料只给'发生什么'，虚构给'为什么发生'与'它意味着什么'，孔明借东风就是把'偶然东南风'编码成'人谋通天'；第三，虚实配比是可调参数——七三配比让作品既可当历史读又可当小说读，这是它统治中国人历史想象六百年的技术原因。他证明：可信的虚构不靠想象力，靠把想象力安装在不可辩驳的骨架上
modes.domain_en: Zhang Xuecheng later judged the Romance: 'seven parts real fact, three parts fiction, so that readers are often misled by it' — seven words that describe Luo Guanzhong's construction exactly: the great skeleton (the Yellow Turbans, Guandu, the Red Cliffs, the six campaigns from Qishan, the Jin conquest) is nailed fast to the histories, and fiction grows only in the skeleton's gaps — the detail of borrowing arrows with straw boats, the rite of summoning the east wind, the transplanted empty fort. The depth of the judgment: first, the skeleton issues fiction its passport — because the dynasties, the battles and the outcomes are beyond dispute, the fiction in the gaps is accepted as credible filling; second, fiction supplies causality — the archive says only what happened; fiction says why and what it means, and Kongming summoning the east wind encodes 'a chance southeast wind' as 'human strategy reaching heaven'; third, the ratio is a tunable parameter — seven-to-three lets the work be read as history and as novel at once, the technical reason it has ruled the Chinese imagination of that age for six hundred years. He proved: credible fiction rests not on imagination but on installing imagination upon a skeleton beyond dispute
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志通俗演义》全书构造；章学诚《丙辰札记》'七分实事，三分虚构'
modes.key_quote_zh: 七分实事，三分虚构——虚构的通行证由不可辩驳的骨架签发
modes.key_quote_en: "Seven parts real fact, three parts fiction — the passport of fiction is signed by a skeleton beyond dispute"
process_zh: 先把不可辩驳的骨架钉死：时间线、大事件、最终结局全部采用最硬的来源——骨架的硬度决定整座建筑的可信度
只在缝隙里安装虚构：战役的结局不碰，战役的过程可以写；人物的生死不碰，人物的话可以造——虚构位置比虚构内容更重要
让虚构回答史料不回答的问题：史料给'什么发生'，你的虚构补'为何发生、何等意味'——虚构的职责是因果与意义，不是另编事件
公开并坚持配比：让读者知道何处是实、何处是虚（或至少事后可核），配比稳定的作品才能长期借用历史的信用
process_en: Nail down the skeleton beyond dispute: the timeline, the great events, the final outcome all from the hardest sources — the skeleton's hardness sets the whole building's credibility

Install fiction only in the gaps: touch not the outcome of a battle but you may write its course; touch not who dies but you may invent what they say — where you place fiction matters more than what you invent
Let fiction answer what the archive does not: the archive gives what happened; your fiction supplies why and what it means — fiction's duty is cause and meaning, not new events
Publish and keep the ratio: let readers know (or at least be able to check later) what is fact and what fiction — only a stable ratio may borrow history's credit for long
representative_cases_zh: 草船借箭：史实原型是孙权濡须之战的偶然事件，罗贯中把它移植给孔明并升级为'三天十万箭'的完胜设计——一次移植完成人物神化
空城计：正史注中的郭冲三事、裴松之已驳其不实，罗贯中仍采用并安放在马谡失街亭的绝境里——缝隙处的虚构让'智绝'定格
赤壁之战：火攻、连环、结局全遵史册，'借东风''草船借箭''华容道'三段著名虚构全嵌在战前与战后的缝隙——大战役骨架上的虚构群
representative_cases_en: Borrowing arrows with straw boats: the historical kernel is a chance episode of Sun Quan at Ruxu; Luo transplants it to Kongming and upgrades it to a perfect win of a hundred thousand arrows in three days — one transplant completes a deification

The empty fort: an anecdote in Pei Songzhi's notes, already refuted as unhistorical, yet Luo adopts it and sets it in the despair after the loss of Jieting — fiction in the gap fixes 'the summit of wisdom' in place

The battle of Red Cliffs: the fire attack, the chained ships, the outcome all follow the histories, while the three famous fictions — summoning the east wind, the straw boats, the pass at Huarong — all nest before and after the battle: a cluster of fiction on the skeleton of a great campaign
modern_applications_zh: 写史/写案先钉骨架：非虚构写作把可核查的事实（日期、数字、结局）钉死，演绎只放在'当时说了什么、想了什么'的缝隙——可信度与可读性兼得
产品的'骨架承诺'：对外承诺不可辩驳的部分（发布日期、硬指标），愿景放在缝隙里——信用管理即虚实配比管理
教育中的七三结构：先教不可动摇的基础事实，再用情境虚构（案例、推演）填充因果理解——学生'为所惑乱'的风险靠标注配比控制
modern_applications_en: Nail the skeleton before writing history or case studies: in nonfiction, pin the verifiable — dates, figures, outcomes — and put dramatic reconstruction only in the gaps of what was said and thought; credibility and readability together
The skeleton promise in product: commit beyond dispute to what is checkable — ship dates, hard specs — and set vision in the gaps; credit management is ratio management

The seven-three structure in teaching: teach the immovable facts first, then fill causal understanding with situational fictions — cases and simulations — the risk of misleading controlled by labeling the ratio
representative_figures: 罗贯中
章学诚（'七实三虚'的命名者与批评者）
陈寿（提供骨架的《三国志》作者）
裴松之（以注补史、也以注驳伪的史料审计者）
司马迁（在纪传中已经大量使用合理虚构的先行者）
modes.definition_zh: 章学诚后来评《三国演义》：'七分实事，三分虚构，以至观者往往为所惑乱'——这七个字精确描述了罗贯中的构造方法：大的骨架（黄巾、官渡、赤壁、六出祁山、三国归晋）全部钉死在史册上，虚构只在骨架的缝隙里生长（草船借箭的细节、借东风的仪式、空城计的移植）。这个判断的深意在于：第一，骨架给虚构发通行证——正因为朝代、战役、结局不可辩驳，缝隙里的虚构才被读者当作可信的填充接受；第二，虚构负责因果——史料只给'发生什么'，虚构给'为什么发生'与'它意味着什么'，孔明借东风就是把'偶然东南风'编码成'人谋通天'；第三，虚实配比是可调参数——七三配比让作品既可当历史读又可当小说读，这是它统治中国人历史想象六百年的技术原因。他证明：可信的虚构不靠想象力，靠把想象力安装在不可辩驳的骨架上
modes.definition_en: Zhang Xuecheng later judged the Romance: 'seven parts real fact, three parts fiction, so that readers are often misled by it' — seven words that describe Luo Guanzhong's construction exactly: the great skeleton (the Yellow Turbans, Guandu, the Red Cliffs, the six campaigns from Qishan, the Jin conquest) is nailed fast to the histories, and fiction grows only in the skeleton's gaps — the detail of borrowing arrows with straw boats, the rite of summoning the east wind, the transplanted empty fort. The depth of the judgment: first, the skeleton issues fiction its passport — because the dynasties, the battles and the outcomes are beyond dispute, the fiction in the gaps is accepted as credible filling; second, fiction supplies causality — the archive says only what happened; fiction says why and what it means, and Kongming summoning the east wind encodes 'a chance southeast wind' as 'human strategy reaching heaven'; third, the ratio is a tunable parameter — seven-to-three lets the work be read as history and as novel at once, the technical reason it has ruled the Chinese imagination of that age for six hundred years. He proved: credible fiction rests not on imagination but on installing imagination upon a skeleton beyond dispute

modes.name_en: The Method of the Oath Brotherhood
modes.category: 方法论/以'义'为组织第一原理
modes.domain_zh: 《三国志》里刘备与关羽、张飞'恩若兄弟'，仅此四字；罗贯中把它扩写成全书第一幕——桃园一炷香、一句'不求同年同月同日生，但求同年同月同日死'，为整部书写下了组织章程：这个集团的最高法不是君主之命，是结义之誓。这个判断的深意在于：第一，'义'被建构成可执行的制度——誓言有对价（同死）、有违约成本（背义者名裂身死，吕布就是全书反例）、有仲裁（天与天下人）；第二，结义解决宗法制度解决不了的问题——血缘组织靠生出来的忠诚，科层组织靠俸禄买的忠诚，结义制造第三种：自愿选择的、以人格担保的忠诚，这正是乱世最稀缺的资产；第三，义的组织有天花板——它靠人格维持，人格会死（关羽死后誓言的'同日死'只兑现了一半），罗贯中如实写出义的美好与脆裂。他证明：在一切组织技术之上，人类最硬的契约仍是对着天地说出的一句话
modes.domain_en: The History of the Three Kingdoms says of Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei only that they were 'kind as brothers'; Luo Guanzhong expands those four characters into the book's first act — one stick of incense in the peach garden, one line 'we ask not to be born on the same day, but to die on the same day' — and thus writes the group's charter: the highest law of this house is not the sovereign's command but the oath of brotherhood. The depth of the judgment: first, 'righteousness' is built into an executable institution — the oath carries consideration (to die together), a cost of breach (the breaker is torn of name and body; Lü Bu is the book's counterexample), and arbitration (heaven and all the world); second, the oath solves what kinship cannot — blood organizes loyalty by birth, bureaucracy buys loyalty with salary, and sworn brotherhood makes a third: freely chosen loyalty underwritten by one's person, the scarcest asset in an age of disorder; third, the organization of yi has a ceiling — it is kept by character, and character dies (after Guan Yu falls, the oath's 'die on the same day' is only half kept), and Luo writes both the beauty and the cracking of it. He proved: above all organizational technology, the hardest contract mankind holds is still one sentence spoken before heaven and earth
modes.source_chapter: 第一回'宴桃园豪杰三结义'；全书对'义'的组织性书写
modes.key_quote_zh: 不求同年同月同日生，但求同年同月同日死——宗法给不了的忠诚，誓言给了
modes.key_quote_en: "We ask not to be born on the same day, but to die on the same day — the loyalty blood cannot give, the oath does"
process_zh: 为组织写下超越利益的最高法：利益分配规则之上另立一条'不可让渡条款'（誓言、使命、信条）——它平时不启用，危机时是唯一不散的锚
给违约标明代价并执行：背义者不是被罚款，是被逐出意义系统——组织的约束力来自把'被除名'定价为'社会性死亡'
把忠诚变成自愿选择：入伙须经过仪式（宣誓、供认、共担风险）——选择进来的忠诚比生出来的、买来的都抗风暴
如实写出这种组织的边界：人格会死、誓言会断——写出脆裂之处的制度描述才是可信的制度设计
process_en: Write for the group a highest law above interest: over the rules of distribution set one clause that cannot be ceded — an oath, a mission, a creed; idle in peace, it is the only anchor that holds in crisis
Price the breach and enforce it: the oath-breaker is not fined but cast out of the system of meaning — the binding force comes from pricing expulsion as social death
Make loyalty a chosen thing: entry must pass a rite — the oath, the confession, the shared risk; chosen loyalty outlasts the born and the bought in every storm
Write the boundary honestly: character dies, oaths snap — an account of a system that records where it cracks is the only design one can trust
representative_cases_zh: 关羽的'降汉不降曹'：结义条款优先于君臣条款——'但知刘皇叔去向'一句话重排了效忠层级，礼教体系里不可思议，誓言体系里天经地义
吕布之死作为反面判例：'三姓家奴'两弑其主——全书把'无义'的最高刑罚（身死名裂+民间唾骂）判给了最强者，武力第一不豁免义之法庭
白帝托孤的誓言交接：刘备对诸葛亮说'若嗣子可辅则辅之，如其不才君可自取'——把结义之誓延展为跨越一代人的授权与试探
representative_cases_en: Guan Yu's 'surrender to Han, not to Cao': the oath's clause outranks the lord-vassal clause — 'I know only where Imperial Uncle Liu is' reorders the whole hierarchy of loyalty, unthinkable in the rites, self-evident under the oath

The death of Lü Bu as the negative precedent: 'slave of three surnames,' twice the slayer of his foster fathers — the book passes on the strongest warrior the highest penalty of the faithless, body destroyed, name blackened; might exempts no one from the court of yi

The entrusting at Baidicheng as an oath handed on: Liu Bei tells Kongming, 'aid the heir if he can be aided; if he is worthless, take it yourself' — the sworn bond stretched across a generation as both grant and test
modern_applications_zh: 创业团队写'结义条款'：股权与期权之外，共同写一份危机时刻的相互承诺（谁垫钱、谁顶上、谁不走）——平时无效力，散伙危机时是唯一的缆绳
社群运营用仪式建立自愿忠诚：入会仪式、公开承诺、共同风险承担——仪式感不是虚荣，是忠诚的生产工艺
给违约行为定价到'意义层面'：组织里最狠的惩罚不是奖金归零，是除名与信誉标记——设计惩罚先设计'被逐出后意味着什么'
modern_applications_en: Write an oath clause for the founding team: over equity and options, a mutual pledge for the hour of crisis — who puts in money, who stands up, who does not walk; powerless in peace, the only cable when the ship pitches
Build chosen loyalty with rites in community: initiation, public commitment, shared risk — ritual is not vanity but the craft of manufacturing loyalty
Price breach at the level of meaning: the harshest penalty in an organization is not zeroed bonus but removal and the reputation mark — design punishment by first designing what expulsion means

modes.name_en: The Method of the Long Cycle
modes.category: 认知方法/以长周期结构史观统摄叙事
modes.domain_zh: 《三国演义》开卷第一句不是任何人物，而是一条定律：'话说天下大势，分久必合，合久必分'——然后才用周、秦、汉七百年的分合为此定律举证，才引出'致乱之由'。这个判断的深意在于：第一，先给规律再讲故事——读者从第一行就知道结局的方向（合），一切人物挣扎都在被提前告知的结构里进行，宿命感由此而生；第二，个人在周期面前被重新定价——曹操、刘备、诸葛亮再雄才，也只是'合久必分'与'分久必合'之间的一段波动，开篇定律替读者省去了一切'如果当初'的假设；第三，长周期视角是一种安慰技术——'分久必合'对乱世读者意味着苦难有尽头，'合久必分'对承平读者意味着居安思危，一句话同时服务两种处境。他证明：讲一个漫长的故事，最经济的开头是先宣布它服从的定律
modes.domain_en: The first line of the Romance is no character but a law: 'The empire, long divided, must unite; long united, must divide' — only then does it summon seven hundred years of Zhou, Qin and Han to give the law its evidence, and only then the causes of the disorder. The depth of the judgment: first, the law before the story — from the first line the reader knows the direction of the end (union), and all human struggle moves inside a structure announced in advance; fatalism is born there; second, persons are repriced against the cycle — Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Kongming, heroes all, are yet one stretch of the wave between division and union, and the opening law spares the reader every 'if only'; third, the long-cycle view is a technology of consolation — 'long divided, must unite' tells the reader in disorder that suffering has an end, and 'long united, must divide' tells the reader at peace to guard against ruin — one sentence serving both estates. He proved: to tell a long story, the most economical opening is to announce the law it obeys
modes.source_chapter: 《三国志通俗演义》开篇第一句；全书以'三分归晋'收束的环形结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下大势，分久必合，合久必分——先宣布定律，再讲百年人事
modes.key_quote_en: "The empire, long divided, must unite; long united, must divide — announce the law first, then tell the hundred years of men"
process_zh: 用一句可检验的定律开篇：先给读者'故事服从什么规律'，再进入细节——定律越简短，统摄越有力
为定律列举跨时代证据：用定律之外的长时段事例（周秦汉七百年）证明它不是为眼前故事量身定做——规律的信用来自它覆盖的范围
把人物放回结构里定价：英雄的成败不解释为偶然，解释为周期的一段——读者的情绪从'惋惜'升级为'理解'
让结局回到定律完成闭环：故事结束于定律预测的形态（三分归晋）——开头的预言被结尾兑现，读者获得结构性的满足
process_en: Open with one testable law: give the reader first the rule the story obeys, then the detail — the shorter the law, the stronger its governance

Prove the law with cross-era evidence: summon examples from beyond the story itself — seven hundred years of Zhou, Qin, Han — to show the law is not tailored to one tale; a rule's credit comes from its coverage
Reprice persons inside the structure: the hero's rise and fall explained not as chance but as one stretch of the cycle — the reader's feeling rises from regret to understanding
Close the loop by returning to the law: end where the law predicted — the three return to one; the opening prophecy cashed by the ending gives the reader structural satisfaction
representative_cases_zh: 开篇七百年举证：'周七百年分为战国……汉四百年光武中兴……'——用一个段落把眼前三国嵌进千年级周期，史诗尺度一步到位
'三分归晋'的环形收束：全书一切智谋血战，终点被开篇第一句写定——诸葛亮的悲剧因此不是意外而是'天数'，读者的痛感被结构吸收
杨慎《临江仙》'是非成败转头空'的卷首词：把周期律再推一层到价值层——成败本身也被周期化，全书的情感基调由此定盘
representative_cases_en: The seven-hundred-year proof of the opening: one paragraph sets Zhou divided into warring states and Han's four hundred years with its restoration, nesting the Three Kingdoms inside a millennial cycle — epic scale in a single step

The ring-closing of 'the three return to one': every stratagem and every battle ends where the first sentence fixed it — Kongming's tragedy is therefore no accident but 'the number of heaven,' and the reader's grief is absorbed by the structure

Yang Shen's opening song, 'right and wrong, success and failure, turn empty with a turn of the head': the cycle pushed one layer further to value itself — even success and failure are cycled, and the book's emotional key is set
modern_applications_zh: 长报告先给定律：行业分析、战略备忘开头先用一句话给出你发现的周期或规律，再用正文举证——读者带着框架读，信息吸收率倍增
以周期定价个人处境：把'行业下行''职业挫折'放进长周期看（萧条后必有重建），情绪管理从安慰升级为结构理解
机构史写作用环形结构：组织周年史以创始愿景开篇、以愿景的当代形态收束——让百年人事在结构里获得意义而非流水账
modern_applications_en: Lead the long report with the law: in industry analysis or strategy memos, state the cycle you found in one sentence, then marshal the body as evidence — the reader reads with a frame and absorbs double

Price one's situation by the cycle: set the industry downturn, the career setback, inside a long cycle — after contraction, rebuilding — and emotional management rises from consolation to structural understanding

Ring-structure the institutional history: open the anniversary history with the founding vision, close with that vision's present form — a century of affairs given meaning by structure, not a chronicle

modes.name_en: The Method of the Stratagem Template
modes.category: 方法论/把斗争智慧提炼为可复用程式
modes.domain_zh: 罗贯中写智斗从不满足于'某某赢了'，他总是把每一场胜利拆成可复述、可迁移的程式：草船借箭='用敌人的标准武库为我生产'；空城计='把弱点本身演成陷阱'；欲擒故纵='先给对方想要的，收回时连本带利'；三气周瑜='在同一条心理断层上反复加压'。这些程式与民间'三十六计'相互灌溉，最终成为中国人斗争思维的通用语。这个判断的深意在于：第一，把个案提炼为模板是知识的浓缩——一场战役几千字，模板四字可传（借刀杀人、以逸待劳），传播效率提升百倍；第二，模板自带演练价值——读者读程式不是读历史，是在脑内沙盘推演'我遇到此局怎么办'，演义因此成为六百年的决策训练教材；第三，程式要配解药——罗贯中同时写出识破程式的方法（识破空城计的司马懿之疑、将计就计的反杀），模板库是双向的。他证明：智慧要传世，必须被压缩成可复述的形状
modes.domain_en: In writing contests of wits Luo Guanzhong never rests at 'so-and-so won'; he takes every victory apart into a retellable, transferable template: the straw-boat arrows = 'make the enemy's own arsenal produce for you'; the empty fort = 'act your weakness itself into a trap'; release to capture = 'give first what he wants, and take it back with interest'; thrice enraging Zhou Yu = 'load the same psychological fault line again and again.' These templates, cross-fertilizing the folk Thirty-Six Stratagems, became the common tongue of Chinese strategic thought. The depth of the judgment: first, distilling the case into a template concentrates knowledge — a battle of several thousand characters, a template of four (borrow the knife, await the weary at ease); the efficiency of transmission gains a hundredfold; second, the template carries its own rehearsal — the reader of a stratagem is not reading history but war-gaming in the head 'what would I do in this position'; the Romance is thus a decision-training textbook six hundred years old; third, each template ships with its antidote — Luo writes too the ways of seeing through (Sima Yi's doubt before the empty fort, the counter-trap of turning the enemy's plan) — the library is two-way. He proved: for wisdom to survive, it must be compressed into a retellable shape
modes.source_chapter: 草船借箭、空城计、欲擒故纵（七擒孟获）、三气周瑜等谋略段落
modes.key_quote_zh: 一场战役几千字，一个计名四字传——把智慧压缩成可复述的形状
modes.key_quote_en: "A battle of a thousand words, a stratagem of four — wisdom compressed into a shape that can be retold"
process_zh: 每处理完一个对抗性案例，强制产出'四字模板'：这个胜局的机制是什么？能用几个字说清？——说不清就还没真的理解
给模板标注适用条件与失效条件：'空城计'的前提是对方多疑——写出边界条件的模板才可迁移
为每个模板准备反制：把'识破此计'的路径同时入库——只有矛的武器库会武装敌人
用重复场景测试模板：同一程式在不同战役中复现（火攻用两次、诈降用三次）——复现一次，可信度与可学性翻倍
process_en: After each adversarial case, force out a four-character template: what is this win's mechanism, and can it be said in a few words — until you can, you have not understood it
Tag each template with its conditions and its failure modes: the empty fort presupposes a suspicious opponent — a template with boundaries is one that transfers
Prepare an antidote for every template: file the path of seeing through alongside the stratagem itself — an armory of only spears arms the enemy
Test the template across repeated scenes: the same device recurs in different campaigns — fire attack twice, feigned surrender thrice — one recurrence, and credibility and learnability both double
representative_cases_zh: 草船借箭的机制抽象：'借'类计策的原型——用对方的资源系统、考核压力（三日限期）与情报盲区（大雾）完成自产自销——后世一切'借势'话术的祖先
七擒孟获即'欲擒故纵'的规程化：七次程序化的放与擒，把一个计策写成一套带步骤的攻心流程——'攻心为上'从口号变成可执行清单
空城计的双向教学：司马懿的'宁信其有'与孔明的'知其必疑'同场展示——同一个程式同时给了施计方与破解方两份作业
representative_cases_en: The abstraction of the straw-boat arrows: the archetype of the 'borrow' family — using the enemy's own resource system, his own assessment pressure of a three-day deadline, and his intelligence blind spot of the fog to produce for oneself — ancestor of every later rhetoric of 'riding the momentum'

Seven captures of Meng Huo as procedure: the ritualized seven releases and recaptures write one stratagem as a stepwise process of winning hearts — 'to conquer hearts first' turned from slogan into executable checklist
The empty fort as two-way instruction: Sima Yi's 'safer to believe it real' and Kongming's 'I know he must doubt' shown on the same stage — one device, homework for both the schemer and the solver
modern_applications_zh: 复盘强制产出模板：项目复盘不止写'学到了什么'，写'可四字命名的机制'（借势打法、灰度试错）——组织的策略库从故事升级为索引
谈判前查'计名对照表'：把对方行为对照已知程式（拖延=以逸待劳？先赠=欲擒故纵？）——识别程式是反制程式的第一步
写'带解药的playbook'：销售、安全、竞争策略文档每个打法必配'被识破怎么办'——双向武器库才不会在对手读过同一本书时失效
modern_applications_en: Force a template from every retrospective: not only 'what we learned' but 'the mechanism, nameable in four words' — the organization's strategy library upgraded from stories to an index

Check the stratagem table before negotiating: match the other side's behavior to known patterns — stalling as awaiting the weary at ease, the first gift as release to capture; recognizing the pattern is the first step of countering it
Write the playbook with its antidote: in sales, security, competitive strategy, every play ships with 'what if seen through' — a two-way armory survives an opponent who has read the same book

modes.name_en: The Method of the Ensemble Counterpoint
modes.category: 方法论/以人物对写代替单主角叙事
modes.domain_zh: 罗贯中的书没有唯一主角——它有曹操、刘备、诸葛亮、关羽、张飞、赵云、周瑜、司马懿等一组性格互为参照的人物，且用'对写'技术把他们绑在一起：奸与仁对写（曹操杀吕伯奢全家对刘备携民渡江）、智与智对写（周瑜之才以孔明为量尺）、勇与勇对写（许褚裸衣斗马超以张飞为镜）。这个判断的深意在于：第一，人物在关系中被定义——'智绝'孔明若无周瑜与司马懿两组对手，其智无从显影，对手是人格的显影液；第二，群像让结构免于崩塌——单主角叙事里主角退场故事即塌，群像结构里一个人物死（关羽）只是换一层冲突上场，全书撑得住百年的叙事长度；第三，对写是最高效的性格刻画——'既生瑜何生亮'六个字同时完成两个人的造型，比各自千言更省更狠。他证明：要写透一个人物，就去写他的敌人
modes.domain_en: Luo Guanzhong's book has no single hero — it has a cast whose characters are each other's reference points: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Kongming, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhou Yu, Sima Yi — bound by the technique of counter-writing: treachery against benevolence (Cao's slaughter of the Lü household against Liu's flight with the people), wit against wit (Zhou Yu's talent measured against Kongming), courage against courage (Xu Chu fighting Ma Xu bare-chested mirrored by Zhang Fei). The depth of the judgment: first, a person is defined in relation — 'the summit of wisdom' Kongming could not show without two sets of opponents, Zhou Yu and Sima Yi; the rival is the developing fluid of character; second, the ensemble keeps the structure from collapsing — in a single-hero tale the story falls when the hero exits; in an ensemble one death (Guan Yu's) only brings the next layer of conflict onstage, and the book sustains a century of narrative; third, counter-writing is the most economical portraiture — 'Had Yu been born, why Liang?' shapes two persons in six characters, sharper than a thousand each. He proved: to write a person through, write his enemy
modes.source_chapter: 曹操/刘备对写、周瑜与孔明斗智、司马懿对峙五丈原等对位结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 既生瑜，何生亮——六个字完成两个人的造型：要写透一个人物，先写他的敌人
modes.key_quote_en: "Had Yu been born, why Liang? — two portraits in six characters: to write a person through, first write his enemy"
process_zh: 先配对再造型：为你的人物找到'参照系对手'——同一维度上的强对立（智对智、勇对勇、仁对奸），没有对手的人格写不立体
用同场竞技替代分别描写：让两人在同一场冲突里各自出手——对比在对戏中自然发生，不需要作者跳出来评论
安排'三绝'式的光谱而非二元：奸（曹操）、义（关羽）、智（孔明）分居三个极点，中间保留大量过渡人物——光谱越宽，世界越真
让人物退场后冲突升级而非塌方：预先设计好每根支柱退场时由谁接住冲突（关羽死后夷陵之战接上）——群像结构需要预案
process_en: Pair before you portray: find your person the reference rival — a strong opposite on the same axis, wit against wit, courage against courage, benevolence against treachery; no character stands in relief without an opponent
Prefer the shared arena to separate description: let the two act in the same conflict and the comparison happens inside the scene, with no author stepping out to judge
Build a spectrum, not a binary: treachery (Cao Cao), fidelity (Guan Yu), wisdom (Kongming) at three poles with many gradations between — the wider the spectrum, the truer the world
Design the catch when a pillar exits: plan in advance who takes the conflict when each falls — Guan Yu's death caught by the battle of Yiling; an ensemble needs its contingency
representative_cases_zh: '三绝'的对位设计：毛宗岗总结的奸绝曹操、义绝关羽、智绝孔明——三个人格极点互为坐标，全书群像围绕三个极点组织
周瑜作为'智'的量尺：孔明三气周瑜的每一气都在证明对手的量级——周瑜越雄姿英发，孔明的胜利越有含金量——把对手写强是抬高主角的合法手段
赵云与关羽的勇之对写：长坂坡七进七出（救主之勇）与过五关斩六将（守义之勇）——同一种武力被写成两种道德颜色
representative_cases_en: The counterpoint of the 'three summits': Mao Zonggang's catalog — Cao Cao summit of treachery, Guan Yu of fidelity, Kongming of wisdom — three poles of personhood as the coordinates around which the whole cast is organized

Zhou Yu as the measure of wisdom: each of the three enragings proves the opponent's caliber — the more 'spinning like a wheel' Zhou Yu's dash, the heavier Kongming's victory; to write the rival strong is the lawful way to raise the hero

Zhao Yun and Guan Yu, two colors of courage: seven times into and out of Changban (courage of rescue) against the five passes and six generals (courage of fidelity) — one martial force rendered in two moral colors
modern_applications_zh: 组织人才盘点用'对位法'：评价一个高管，同时写出他最强对手/互补者的画像——孤立的人才描述会失真，关系网里的人才才真实
品牌传播用'宿敌叙事'：为品牌找一个值得尊敬的对手（可乐之战）——对手的量级决定你的量级，正面强比贬低对手更抬升自己
传记/深度报道用群像结构：写一个组织不止写一号人物，写一组互为参照的人——人物退场后故事靠关系结构撑住
modern_applications_en: Talent review by counterpoint: to appraise an executive, write at the same time the portrait of his strongest rival or complement — a person described alone distorts; only in the web is a person true
The rival narrative in brand: find the brand a worthy enemy, as in the cola wars — the rival's caliber sets yours, and a fair fight lifts you higher than belittling ever will
The ensemble structure in biography and reportage: write an organization not through its No. 1 but through a set of mutual reference points — when a figure exits, the web of relations holds the story

modes.name_en: The Method of the Timed Feat
modes.category: 方法论/用物理时间刻度度量英雄高度
modes.domain_zh: 罗贯中写关羽斩华雄，一整场大战一个字不写：只写'其酒尚温'——曹操斟的热酒出发时是热的，关羽提头回来还是热的。这个判断的深意在于：第一，用最短的物理时间度量不可见的力量——温酒是可感的刻度，'武艺天下第一'是抽象的断言，把抽象钉在具体物性上，断言变成可验证的体验；第二，留白比铺陈更有力——不写战斗是最高级的战斗描写，读者的想象永远比文字快，温酒斩将证明'省略'是一种可以精确控制的叙事参数；第三，同一刻度可反复校准——全书用不同时间刻度度量不同高度：过五关是一路的时间、刮骨疗毒是谈笑之间、水淹七军是天下震动——刻度体系让英雄的层级可比较。他证明：写力量的最高技术，是发明一把让读者自己测量的尺
modes.domain_en: In writing Guan Yu beheading Hua Xiong, Luo Guanzhong spends not one word on the battle: only 'the wine was still warm' — the cup Cao Cao poured warm went out warm and came back warm with the head. The depth of the judgment: first, measure invisible force with the shortest physical time — warm wine is a felt scale, 'first in arms under heaven' an abstract claim; pinning the abstract to a physical property turns assertion into verifiable experience; second, the blank is stronger than the battle scene — to write no battle is the highest writing of battle, for the reader's imagination always outruns the page; the warm-wine beheading proves omission a precisely tunable narrative parameter; third, one scale can be recalibrated across the book — the five passes are the time of a road, the scraping of the bone the space of a jest, the drowning of the seven armies the trembling of the realm — a system of scales makes heroes comparable. He proved: the highest craft of writing power is to invent the ruler and let the reader take the measurement himself
modes.source_chapter: 第五回'关云长温酒斩华雄'；刮骨疗毒、长坂坡等时间刻度段落
modes.key_quote_zh: 其酒尚温——不写战斗一个字，让读者自己测量英雄的高度
modes.key_quote_en: "The wine was still warm — not one word of the fight; let the reader take the measure of the hero himself"
process_zh: 为抽象能力找一个可感的物理刻度：不写'能力强'，写'酒还是温的'——把断言换算成读者可自行验证的物性
关键高潮处使用省略：最重要的事件不直接描写，只写事件前后的两帧（出发时的酒、回来时的头）——想象替你完成战斗
建立可比较的刻度体系：全书用一致的时间/物性刻度度量不同层级——刻度一致，'温酒'与'刮骨'才可放在同一坐标系
用旁观者反应替代作者断言：'诸将大惊'、曹操抚掌——把评价权交给场景中的人，作者退到幕后
process_en: Find a felt physical scale for the abstract power: write not 'peerless' but 'the wine still warm' — convert the assertion into a property the reader can verify himself
Use omission at the climax: the most important event described not directly but by two frames around it — the cup going out, the head coming back; imagination finishes the battle for you
Build a comparable system of scales: measure different grades by a consistent scale of time and physical property, so 'the warm wine' and 'the scraped bone' share one coordinate system
Let bystanders replace the author's verdict: the generals astonished, Cao Cao clapping — hand the judgment to the people in the scene and step behind the curtain
representative_cases_zh: 温酒斩华雄的全刻度设计：出征前曹操'酾热酒一杯'、斩将后'其酒尚温'、帐外鼓声由喊杀到寂静——三层刻度（温度、声音、首级）同时测量一场没写的战斗
长坂坡的时间膨胀：同是时间刻度，此处反向使用——赵云七进七出写足半天，让'怀揣阿斗血染征袍'的 endurance 被拉长度量——快与慢都是同一把尺的用法
刮骨疗毒的'谈笑'刻度：以棋局与谈笑声度量痛感——刻度从物理时间扩展到精神强度
representative_cases_en: The full scale of the warm-wine beheading: the hot cup poured before, 'the wine still warm' after, the drums outside passing from clamor to silence — three scales at once, temperature, sound, and head, measuring a battle never written

The dilation of time at Changban: the same scale used in reverse — Zhao Yun's seven charges given half a day's length, so the endurance of 'the babe in his cuirass, his robe soaked red' can be measured — fast and slow are two uses of one ruler
The scale of 'amid jest' in the scraped bone: the chess game and the laughter measuring pain — the scale extended from physical time to spiritual strength
modern_applications_zh: 产品演示用'可感刻度'代替形容词：不写'极速'，写'倒水的时间加载完成'——把性能钉在物理事件上，用户自己测量
关键数据用'两帧省略法'呈现：最重要的成果不铺陈过程，只给前后两个状态（改造前/改造后）——留白引发追问，追问引发关注
用旁观者反应做社会证明：案例里不写'客户很满意'，引用一句'他们说我们疯了，三个月后他们续了三年合同'——评价由场景中的人说出
modern_applications_en: Replace adjectives with a felt scale in demos: write not 'blazing fast' but 'loads in the time of pouring water' — pin performance to a physical event and let the user take the measure
Show the key result by two frames: the most important achievement told not by process but by state before and after — the blank invites the question, the question invites the attention

Let bystanders do the social proof: in the case study write not 'the client was satisfied' but a line — 'they called us mad; three months later they signed three years' — the verdict spoken from inside the scene

毛宗岗（对此类'衬笔'的评点理论化）
海明威（'冰山理论'——省略作为叙事技术的西方平行）
杜甫（'朱门酒肉臭'以一个物象刻度写尽制度之重）
modes.definition_zh: 罗贯中写关羽斩华雄，一整场大战一个字不写：只写'其酒尚温'——曹操斟的热酒出发时是热的，关羽提头回来还是热的。这个判断的深意在于：第一，用最短的物理时间度量不可见的力量——温酒是可感的刻度，'武艺天下第一'是抽象的断言，把抽象钉在具体物性上，断言变成可验证的体验；第二，留白比铺陈更有力——不写战斗是最高级的战斗描写，读者的想象永远比文字快，温酒斩将证明'省略'是一种可以精确控制的叙事参数；第三，同一刻度可反复校准——全书用不同时间刻度度量不同高度：过五关是一路的时间、刮骨疗毒是谈笑之间、水淹七军是天下震动——刻度体系让英雄的层级可比较。他证明：写力量的最高技术，是发明一把让读者自己测量的尺
modes.definition_en: In writing Guan Yu beheading Hua Xiong, Luo Guanzhong spends not one word on the battle: only 'the wine was still warm' — the cup Cao Cao poured warm went out warm and came back warm with the head. The depth of the judgment: first, measure invisible force with the shortest physical time — warm wine is a felt scale, 'first in arms under heaven' an abstract claim; pinning the abstract to a physical property turns assertion into verifiable experience; second, the blank is stronger than the battle scene — to write no battle is the highest writing of battle, for the reader's imagination always outruns the page; the warm-wine beheading proves omission a precisely tunable narrative parameter; third, one scale can be recalibrated across the book — the five passes are the time of a road, the scraping of the bone the space of a jest, the drowning of the seven armies the trembling of the realm — a system of scales makes heroes comparable. He proved: the highest craft of writing power is to invent the ruler and let the reader take the measurement himself

modes.name_en: The Method of the Grand Tide and the Small Detail
modes.category: 方法论/在宏观必然与微观偶然之间架桥
modes.domain_zh: 《三国演义》的双层节奏：大势层写'天下大势分久必合'的必然（谁都无法阻挡三分与归晋），小节层写草船借箭的雾、借东风的幡、煮酒论英雄的那声惊雷——宏观层决定'会怎样'，微观层决定'如何发生'。这个判断的深意在于：第一，必然性需要偶然性来演出——若只有大势，故事是流水账；若只有小节，故事失重；罗贯中让每一段小机巧都发生在大势的坡道上，雾是赤壁的雾，幡是七星坛的幡；第二，微观细节是宏观命名的证人——'煮酒论英雄'一场小宴，把'天下英雄唯使君与操耳'这句宏观判决写进一个具体的雷声里——大判断必须落在小场景才可感；第三，双层结构给读者双份满足——读大势获得理解，读小节获得紧张，两者交替是长篇叙事的呼吸。他证明：写大事的技术不在于写大，在于让大落在足够小的具体物上
modes.domain_en: The Romance runs on a two-story rhythm: the grand-tide layer tells the inevitable — 'long divided must unite' — three kingdoms and the Jin conquest that none can stop; the small-detail layer tells the fog of the straw boats, the banners of the seven-star altar, the crash of thunder at the wine-boiling — the macro layer decides what will be, the micro layer how it happens. The depth of the judgment: first, necessity needs contingency to perform — only the tide gives a chronicle, only the details a loose kite; Luo sets every small artifice on the slope of the tide — the fog is the fog of Red Cliffs, the banners those of the altar; second, the small detail is the witness that names the macro — one small banquet over boiling wine carries the grand verdict 'the heroes of the realm are my lord and you alone' into a single crash of thunder; a great judgment must land in a small scene to be felt; third, the two layers pay the reader twice — understanding from the tide, tension from the detail, and their alternation is the breathing of long narrative. He proved: the craft of writing great things lies not in writing large but in letting the great land on something small and concrete enough
modes.source_chapter: 煮酒论英雄、草船借箭等'小场景承载大判断'的结构段落
modes.key_quote_zh: 天下英雄，唯使君与操耳——宏观判决写进一声惊雷，大事必须落在小场景
modes.key_quote_en: "The heroes of the realm are my lord and you alone — the grand verdict carried into one crash of thunder; the great must land in the small"
process_zh: 先写'会怎样'再写'如何发生'：任何大判断（趋势、结论、战略）配一个小场景作为它的演出场——判决书配一次庭审
给宏观必然找微观证人：趋势不能自己作证，让它落进一个具体物（一声雷、一杯酒、一页数据）——可感的证人才让判断可信
保持双层交替的呼吸：连续三段以上停留在同一层（全是宏观或全是细节）就换层——长叙事的张力来自换挡
让小节服从大势但保留意外空间：小事件的结果可以意外（惊雷可以吓掉筷子），大势的方向不意外——意外写在手段上，不写在结局上
process_en: Write 'what will be' first, then 'how it happens': pair every grand judgment — trend, conclusion, strategy — with a small scene as its stage of performance; the verdict gets its trial

Find the micro witness for the macro necessity: a trend cannot testify for itself; let it land on one concrete thing — a crash of thunder, a cup of wine, a page of figures; only a felt witness makes the judgment believed
Keep the two layers breathing in alternation: three paragraphs on one level — all macro or all detail — and change gears; the tension of long narrative comes from the shifting

Let the small obey the tide yet keep room for surprise: small outcomes may surprise — the thunder may startle the chopsticks loose — but the tide's direction does not; write the surprise in the means, never in the ending
representative_cases_zh: 煮酒论英雄的'一雷双写'：青梅、小亭、天外龙挂全是小节，'唯使君与操耳'是大势级判决，刘备落箸与'圣人迅雷风烈必变'的掩饰——小节层的惊慌被转化成大势层的忠厚形象——两层在同一声雷里交换价值
草船借箭的双重挂靠：大雾（小节的偶然）+ 周瑜十日之限（大势的敌意）——一场机智同时被必然（必有一箭之仇要报）与偶然（必有此雾）支撑
白帝托孤：刘备之死是大势层早已注定的节点，但'君可自取'三字与诸葛亮汗流遍体是小节层的悬案——必然的框架里装一次真正的未知
representative_cases_en: One thunder written twice at the wine-boiling: green plums, a small pavilion, the dragon hanging in the sky — all small detail; 'the heroes of the realm are my lord and you alone' — a verdict on the scale of the tide; Liu Bei's dropped chopsticks converted by 'the sage quickens at thunder and wind' — the small layer's panic exchanged, in one thunderclap, for the grand layer's image of loyalty

The straw-boat arrows hung on both stories: the fog (a small contingency) plus Zhou Yu's ten-day limit (the tide's hostility) — one feat supported at once by the necessary (the grudge must be repaid) and the contingent (the fog must come)

The entrusting at Baidicheng: Liu Bei's death a node fixed long since on the tide layer, while the three words 'take it yourself' and Kongming's sweat-drenched body are a small-layer hanging case — real uncertainty framed inside necessity
modern_applications_zh: 战略沟通配'小场景证人'：讲行业趋势必配一个具体客户的具体下午（'那天下午他删了我们的产品'）——宏观判断靠微观证人入场
年报/深度报告双层交替：宏观章节后必跟微观章节（一个用户、一笔账、一次故障）——理解与紧张的呼吸节奏让长报告可读
预测性内容管理意外位置：'方向确定、路径开放'的写法——把惊喜写在手段与过程，把确定性留给结论——读者既有安全感又有戏剧感
modern_applications_en: Pair the strategy talk with a small-scene witness: never give the industry trend without one concrete afternoon of one concrete client — 'that afternoon he deleted our product'; the macro judgment enters on a micro witness
Alternate the layers in annual and deep reports: after every macro chapter a micro one — a user, a ledger line, one outage; the breathing of understanding and tension keeps a long report readable

Manage where the surprise sits in forecasts: 'direction fixed, path open' — write the surprise in the means and the process, leave the certainty to the conclusion; the reader holds both security and drama

modes.name_en: The Method of the Storyteller Interface
modes.category: 方法论/为口头传播设计叙事接口
modes.domain_zh: 《三国演义》的母体是宋元说话人的瓦舍技艺——罗贯中保留了整套说书接口：'话说''且说''看官''欲知后事如何'、回目对仗、'有诗为证'。这不是技术落后，而是接口设计：他面向的读者一半不识字，故事要在茶馆里被讲出来才活着。这个判断的深意在于：第一，为最窄的传播带宽设计——口语、韵文、对仗回目都是压缩算法，'温酒斩华雄'五个字的回目可在一次茶歇里完成传播；第二，接口决定内容的存活形态——保留说书接口的三国故事进入评弹、评书、戏曲、年画、连环画，每个媒介都能无障碍接入；反之，接口过窄的作品只能在原媒介存活；第三，'且听下回分解'是留存技术——六百年追更习惯由此养成，章回体是人类的第一次连载协议。他证明：内容要多代存活，先要为每一代设计它接得上的接口
modes.domain_en: The Romance's mother body is the storyteller's art of the Song and Yuan fair-booths, and Luo Guanzhong kept the whole interface: 'the tale tells,' 'now to speak of,' 'gentle reader,' 'would you know what follows,' the antithetical chapter titles, 'there is a poem to prove it.' This was not technical backwardness but interface design: half his audience could not read, and the story lived only if it could be told aloud in a teahouse. The depth of the judgment: first, design for the narrowest bandwidth — the spoken word, the verse, the antithetical title are compression algorithms; the five-character title 'warm wine beheads Hua Xiong' transmits in one tea-break; second, the interface decides the form in which content survives — the Romance with its storyteller interface entered ballad-singing, pingshu, opera, New Year prints, picture-books, each medium plugging in without obstruction; works whose interface is narrow live only in their original medium; third, 'hear it in the next chapter' is a retention technology — the six-hundred-year habit of following a story began here; the chapter-cycle is mankind's first serial protocol. He proved: for content to live across generations, design first the interface each generation can plug into
modes.source_chapter: 全书'话说''且说''欲知后事如何'等说书套语与章回结构
modes.key_quote_zh: 欲知后事如何，且听下回分解——章回体是人类的第一次连载协议
modes.key_quote_en: "Would you know what follows? Hear it in the next chapter — the chapter-cycle is mankind's first serial protocol"
process_zh: 识别你内容的'真实使用现场'：内容在什么场合被消费（手机、茶馆、会议室、屏幕）——为那个现场的带宽与姿态设计，而不是为自己的表达欲设计
保留'说书接口'：开场钩子、承转套语、断点悬念——这些看似俗套的接口是几百年验证过的注意力工程
为二次传播设计可摘录单元：回目、金句、'有诗为证'——每个单元能脱离正文独立存活，才能在别的媒介转生
在断点处精确控场：断在事件将发未发处（'欲知后事'）——断点的位置决定回头的比例，连载协议的本质是断点工程
process_en: Identify where your content is truly consumed: on the phone, in the teahouse, in the meeting room, on the screen — design for that venue's bandwidth and posture, not for your own desire to express
Keep the storyteller interface: the opening hook, the transitional formula, the cliff-break — interfaces that look like cliches are attention engineering validated over centuries

Design excerptable units for second-hand spread: the chapter title, the golden line, 'a poem to prove it' — each unit able to live apart from the body is the only kind that reincarnates in other media
Control the break precisely: cut where the event is about to but has not happened — the position of the break decides the share who return; the essence of the serial protocol is break engineering
representative_cases_zh: 回目作为摘要算法：'关云长温酒斩华雄''宴桃园豪杰三结义'——主语+动作+对仗，一整回被压缩成七字上口口诀，评书艺人与不识字听众共用同一接口
'有诗为证'的权威接口：叙述之外另借诗体盖章——把小说家的虚构接入诗史的信用体系，与'托名史家'异曲同工
关羽败亡即'且听下回分解'的连环断点：大意失荆州→败走麦城→玉泉显圣，每个断点都是一次民间讲唱的重新开书点——章节接口让百年故事可分段传承
representative_cases_en: The chapter title as summary algorithm: 'Guan Yu beheads Hua Xiong while the wine is warm,' 'the heroes swear brotherhood in the peach garden' — subject, deed, antithesis; a whole chapter compressed into seven singable characters, the same interface for the pingshu artist and the hearer who cannot read

'A poem to prove it' as the authority interface: beyond the narration another stamp in verse — plugging the novelist's fiction into the credit system of the poetic history, kin to the borrowed title of the historian

Guan Yu's fall as a chain of breaks: the loss of Jing Province by carelessness, the flight to Maicheng, the manifestation at Jade Spring — every break a fresh opening point for the folk teller; the chapter interface lets a century-old story pass on by segments
modern_applications_zh: 为'被转述场景'设计内容：报告、视频、播客都应假设大部分受众是从别人嘴里听到的——金句、口诀、可复述的三段式就是当代'回目'
长内容强制'且听下回'断点：连载、 newsletter 、课程章节在事件将发未发处断开——断点位置是留存率的第一杠杆
跨媒介预留接口：文章写完先问'哪一段能被截图/口述/转帖而独立成立'——接口越丰富，内容在媒介迁移中存活率越高
modern_applications_en: Design for the retelling scene: assume most of the audience for a report, video or podcast will hear it secondhand — the golden line, the mnemonic, the retellable three-part form are our chapter titles
Force a 'next chapter' break in long content: serials, newsletters, course chapters cut where the event is about to happen — the break's position is the first lever of retention

Reserve interfaces across media: when the piece is done, ask which paragraph survives a screenshot, a spoken retelling, a repost — the richer the interfaces, the higher the survival rate across media migration

modes.name_en: The Method of the Working Self through the Book
modes.category: 个人品格/以终身著述安身立命
modes.domain_zh: 与笔下群星相比，罗贯中本人近乎无名：正史无传，生卒存疑，生平仅存'与人寡合''有志图王'数语，连《三国演义》的著作权都要靠明人一笔'罗贯中撰'与贾仲明《录鬼簿续编》的零星记载拼合。我们确知的只有：他把自己的一切——对王朝兴替的全部观察、'有志图王'而不得的抱负、对'义'与'智'的全部信仰——全部写进了一部书，然后退出历史现场，让书代替他活了六百年。这个判断的深意在于：第一，无名是可选择的策略——托名'志图王者'之笔可以写尽帝王，署名者反而要被帝王之史收录与裁剪；第二，作品是人格的完整存档——他不需要墓志铭，'分久必合'的定律、桃园的誓言、温酒的刻度就是他的全部自我陈述；第三，退场即永生——作者越早从作品中退出，作品越早成为公共财产，'三国'从此属于每一个讲它的人。他证明：把自己压缩进一部书里，是普通人对抗遗忘的最长杠杆
modes.domain_en: Against the galaxy of his own characters, Luo Guanzhong the man is nearly nameless: no biography in the standard histories, his birth and death uncertain, a life reduced to a few phrases — 'of few companions,' 'had kingly ambitions' — and even the authorship of the Romance must be pieced from a Ming editor's line 'compiled by Luo Guanzhong' and scattered notes in Jia Zhongming's supplement to the Register of Ghosts. What we know for certain: he put everything he had — a lifetime's observation of dynasties rising and falling, the thwarted kingly ambition, his whole faith in fidelity and in wisdom — into one book, then withdrew from the stage of history and let the book live six hundred years in his stead. The depth of the judgment: first, anonymity can be a chosen strategy — a pen that 'had kingly ambitions' may write sovereigns without end; the named author, in turn, gets collected and edited by the sovereign's histories; second, the work is the complete archive of a self — he needs no epitaph; the law of division and union, the oath in the peach garden, the scale of the warm wine are his entire self-statement; third, to exit is to live — the earlier the author withdraws from the work, the sooner it becomes public property, and 'the Three Kingdoms' belongs from then on to everyone who tells it. He proved: to compress yourself into a single book is the longest lever ordinary people have against oblivion
modes.source_chapter: 贾仲明《录鬼簿续编》'罗贯中，太原人……与余为忘年交，遭时多故，天各一方，至正甲辰复会，别来又六十余年，竟不知其所终'
modes.key_quote_zh: 正史无传，而书传六百年——把自己压缩进一部书，是对抗遗忘的最长杠杆
modes.key_quote_en: "No biography in the histories, yet the book has lived six hundred years — compress yourself into one book and you hold the longest lever against oblivion"
process_zh: 把身份焦虑转写为作品规格：不得志者最怕无名，罗贯中的解法是把'我要被记住什么'换成'我的书要完成什么'——规格即纪念碑
为核心信念找到最大容量的容器：不是写小册子宣泄，而是选一个能装下全部观察与信仰的长时段题材（一朝兴替）——容器容量决定留存长度
主动从作品退场：不纠缠署名权与释义权，让文本自己面对读者——退场越彻底，作品成为公共财富的速度越快
接受'生平不可考'并让作品自证：为不可考的生平预先准备替代物——一部自足的作品就是最好的传记
process_en: Transmute the anxiety of identity into the caliber of the work: the thwarted fear being namelessness, Luo's answer was to exchange 'what will be remembered of me' for 'what is my book to accomplish' — the caliber is the monument

Find a vessel of maximal capacity for your core beliefs: not a pamphlet of grievance but a long-era subject — the rise and fall of an age — able to hold a lifetime's observation and faith; the vessel's capacity sets how long it stays afloat
Withdraw from the work by choice: fight not over the signature or the right to interpret; let the text face the reader alone — the more complete the exit, the faster the work becomes public wealth
Accept that the life cannot be verified and let the work testify in its place: for an unverifiable life prepare a substitute in advance — a self-sufficient book is the best biography
representative_cases_zh: '有志图王'的转写证据链：贾仲明记他'遭时多故''竟不知其所终'——一个乱世抱负无处安放的人，把帝王之志全部转写进写帝王之书——著作即未遂人生的完整镜像
托名与真名之谜本身是作品的一部分：明刊本题'罗贯中撰'而版本系统庞杂，后世为著作权考辩数百年——作者主动退场后，考据者替他续写了六百年传记
施罗并称与'三国''水浒'双名著的传统：一个人名同时挂在两大体系上，而生平几近于零——人格密度与史料密度完全倒挂，倒挂处正是'以书代身'的完成度
representative_cases_en: The chain of evidence for the transmuted ambition: Jia Zhongming records 'tossed by the troubled times' and 'his end unknown' — a man whose kingly hopes had nowhere to land wrote them all into a book about kings; the book is the complete mirror of an unfulfilled life

The authorship riddle as part of the work: Ming editions say 'compiled by Luo Guanzhong' while the textual tradition sprawls, and centuries of scholarship have argued the question — after the author's chosen exit, the scholars wrote his biography for six hundred years

The paired name with Shi Nai'an, over two masterworks: one name hung on two great systems while the life behind it is nearly zero — density of person and density of sources in perfect inversion, and the inversion is the measure of how completely the book replaced the man
modern_applications_zh: 把职业挫折转写为作品规格：晋升无门、身份不显时，把'被谁认可'的课题换成'做出什么规格的东西'——作品规格是独立于职级的第二计分板
选择'最大容量'的长期课题：中途退场不可避免，选一个装得下全部积累的容器（一部体系、一个标准、一家机构）——容量决定退场后还能工作多久
刻意练习'作品先于身份'：署名、头衔、曝光都让渡给作品本身——完成后不恋战、不控评，让作品进入公共领域为你工作
modern_applications_en: Transmute career setback into the caliber of the work: when promotion is shut and title dim, exchange 'who will recognize me' for 'what caliber of thing will I make' — the caliber of the work is a second scoreboard independent of rank

Choose the long subject of maximal capacity: an early exit is unavoidable; pick a vessel that holds all you have accumulated — a system, a standard, an institution; capacity decides how long you keep working after you leave

Practice 'the work before the identity': cede the signature, the title, the spotlight to the work itself — and when it is done, do not cling and do not police the reading; let it into the public domain, where it works for you
representative_figures: 罗贯中
施耐庵（同为'生平近零而书传不朽'的并存样本）
曹雪芹（'披阅十载'而生平付阙、以一书立命的继承者）
费尔米林（澳洲原住民口传史诗 '大故事' 的托名传承者）
莎士比亚（生平史料稀薄而作品自证完整的西方平行）
